moldovaLanding.HeroSection.title: Digital Vouchers for Day Laborers
moldovaLanding.HeroSection.description1: The Ministry of Labor and Social Protection is launching the project "Digital Vouchers for Day Laborers," an initiative aimed at improving the social protection of day laborers in agriculture and simplifying the processes for paying social contributions.
moldovaLanding.HeroSection.description2: The project aims to combat undeclared work and create a transparent and efficient digital system for managing payments for day laborers.
moldovaLanding.HowToApplySection.title: Benefits for farmers and day laborers
moldovaLanding.HowToApplySection.primary: The system ensures the correct and timely payment of social contributions, reducing the risk of sanctions in case of a state inspection.
The platform facilitates the management of payments, eliminating bureaucracy and saving time in complying with legal regulations.
You benefit from continuous support through digital channels, ensuring efficient use of the system and quick resolution of technical issues.
You can track in real-time the social contributions paid for day laborers, eliminating the risk of administrative errors.
moldovaLanding.HowToApplySection.seconda: You benefit from social contributions that give you access to pensions and other benefits.
After 120 days of work, you receive a 60% reimbursement of the voucher value, providing you with greater financial stability.
You work legally without losing other social benefits, such as unemployment assistance or social aid.
You are guaranteed at least the minimum wage for each day of work performed.
moldovaLanding.FAQSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
moldovaLanding.FAQSection.Q1: How can I purchase vouchers for day laborers?
moldovaLanding.FAQSection.Q2: What happens if a day laborer does not show up for work?
moldovaLanding.FAQSection.Q3: Can I purchase vouchers after the work has been completed?
moldovaLanding.FAQSection.A3: No, vouchers can only be purchased and assigned before or on the day the day laborers perform the work. Assigning vouchers after the workday is not allowed.
moldovaLanding.FAQSection.Q4: What documents are required to register on the platform?
moldovaLanding.FAQSection.Q5: What happens if I don't use all the vouchers within a calendar year?

moldovaLanding.AboutTheProgram.title: Implementation Stages
moldovaLanding.AboutTheProgram.descripti: The Energy Compensation Program is a government initiative designed to provide financial support to individuals, households, and businesses struggling to pay their energy bills. The program aims to ensure that all citizens have access to essential energy services and can maintain a comfortable standard of living. By providing compensation to those in need, the program helps reduce energy poverty and promote sustainable energy consumption.

The Energy Compensation Program is available to individuals that meet specific eligibility criteria.

moldovaLanding.AboutThePlatform.title: Pay the Contribution and Activate the Voucher
moldovaLanding.AboutThePlatform.descript: Did you know that 7 out of 10 people in agriculture work in the informal economy in the Republic of Moldova? This means they do not have social insurance and risk having no income in old age. Additionally, informal work creates unfair competition for employers who follow the law and causes the economy to lose significant money. But you can change this! Every voucher you purchase brings us closer to a more fair and sustainable economy. And if you're an employer, by participating, you become part of the solution for legal and protected work.
